description: This file defines data structures and functions for managing device authentication tokens, including loading, storing, and clearing tokens, with persistence to a JSON file.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: A data structure representing an authentication token, role, scopes, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStore
classes.description: An enum providing static methods for managing device authentication tokens, including loading, storing, and clearing tokens, with persistence.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads a token for a given device ID and role if available.

methods.name: storeToken
methods.description: Stores a token for a device ID and role, updating the store file.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes a token for a given device ID and role.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims whitespace characters from a role string.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims whitespace and filters empty scopes, returning a sorted array of unique scopes.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the file URL for the token store JSON file.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads and decodes the token store JSON file into a DeviceAuthStoreFile object.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Encodes and writes the token store object to the JSON file, creating directories as needed.
